title: Toolbox: paint-bucket flood-fill honoring + Rectangle Alt-click dialog + Pen anchor editing (1388 deferred)
description:
Implemented all three deferred toolbox behaviors in packages/authoring-ui (build on 1388/1389).
(a) Paint Bucket Gap Size + Lock Fill: bucketFillRegion gains gapPx (bridges nearby open outline endpoints via gapBridges, invisible fill-only boundary edges, then retries locate); gapSizeToPx maps small/medium/large=4/8/16px zoom-adjusted. Lock Fill stamps a gradient matrix anchored to a fixed reference rect (lockGradientToRect + StageArea lockedFillRectRef) for continuity.
(b) Rectangle/Oval Alt-click exact-dimensions dialog: StageArea exactSizeDialog modal (width/height + corner radius for rect); creates shape at click on OK.
(c) Pen Add/Delete/Convert Anchor editing: tools/penEdit.ts (addAnchorAt splits nearest segment w/ de Casteljau for curves; deleteAnchorAt removes anchor+rejoins; convertAnchorAt toggles corner<->smooth), wired in StageArea pen pointerdown gated on penSubTool.
Threaded bucketGapSize/bucketLockFill/penSubTool props Shell->StageArea.
Verify: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build exit 0. pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui test: 1285 tests pass (113 files); the single 'error' is the pre-existing classesPanel unhandled rejection (task 1423 hotfix), no new failures. New tests: fillSample.test.ts (+10: gap/lock) and penEdit.test.ts (8) all pass.
Docs: docs/04-toolbox.md updated for the three now-honored behaviors.
